route_map.room_costs: 第 1 幕每个房间掉血（中位数/p75，最大生命 70）：普通战 3/8（logged A10 act-1 Monster rooms, n=1127 incl. 8 deaths）；精英 22/36（logged A10 act-1 Elite rooms, n=213 incl. 16 deaths）；问号 0/2（logged A10 act-1 Unknown rooms, n=632）。掉血 = 进房 HP 减下一层 HP（已含燃烧之血、药水、事件），死在房间里记为全部进房 HP；休息回血 = 最大生命 30%（向下取整），锻造不回血。

your_run_plan.archetype: Early damage and AoE into poison and Dexterity defense
your_run_plan.boss_prep: Enter healthy with upgraded AoE, sustained poison, Dexterity-backed block, and useful potions. Reduce follower pressure quickly; reserve Piercing Wail for dangerous multi-hit turns.
your_run_plan.summary: Prioritize efficient attacks and AoE now; add poison scaling and defensive powers next. Remove Strikes after securing damage. Take elites with potions and nearby recovery; upgrade key offense when HP permits.
